newsitem.title: USA: Interpore completes sale of dental business.
newsitem.headline: Interpore completes sale of dental business.

text.p: Interpore International Inc on Friday said it has completed the sale of its dental implant business to Steri-Oss Inc. of Yorba Linda, Calif.
Interpore has received an initial cash payment of $1.5 million. A deferred cash payment of up to $1.5 million, subject to certain purchase price adjustments, is due in January 1998.
As previously reported, the company anticipates that the transaction will generate a one-time loss, which will be recorded in the second quarter of 1997.
